themes.title: Far-right parties push 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying their focus on 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to public services and benefits. This theme is evident in Spain, Italy, and Hungary, where parties like Vox, Lega, and Fidesz/Tisza are advocating for such measures, often sparking debates over their legality and ethical implications.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox continues to push for 'national priority' policies in local and regional governments, demanding that public services and benefits be restricted to Spanish citizens or long-term residents.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega and Fratelli d'Italia have proposed or supported policies that prioritize Italian citizens in areas like housing and social services, often clashing with EU regulations.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: The Tisza Party has proposed constitutional amendments to reinforce national sovereignty, including stricter immigration controls and prioritizing Hungarian citizens in public services.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella have consistently advocated for policies that prioritize French citizens in welfare, healthcare, and employment, often framing immigration as a threat to national identity.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS has promoted policies that emphasize Polish national identity and sovereignty, often opposing EU migration policies and advocating for stricter controls on immigration and social benefits.

themes.title: Trump’s policies dominate global right-wing coverage
themes.blurb: Donald Trump's domestic and foreign policies continue to shape right-wing discourse globally, with his decisions on military deployments, economic measures, and cultural issues resonating in countries like Poland, Argentina, and the UK. His influence is particularly strong in shaping narratives around sovereignty, immigration, and anti-establishment rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's policies, such as military deployments, economic deregulation, and cultural issues like AI oversight and media laws, are central to his administration's agenda and global right-wing discourse.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Poland's right-wing government has closely aligned with Trump's policies, particularly on military cooperation, immigration, and opposition to EU regulations.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government in Argentina has drawn inspiration from Trump's economic policies, including deregulation and anti-socialist rhetoric, while also aligning with his foreign policy stance.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK, led by Nigel Farage, has adopted Trump-like rhetoric on immigration, sovereignty, and anti-establishment politics, positioning itself as a populist alternative to mainstream conservatism.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italy's right-wing parties, particularly Lega, have echoed Trump's anti-immigration and nationalist policies, often aligning with his stance on EU sovereignty and military alliances.

themes.title: Rise of far-right parties in European polls
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe are gaining significant traction in polls, with parties like Germany's AfD, Sweden's Sverigedemokraterna, and France's Rassemblement National leading or making substantial gains. This trend reflects growing voter dissatisfaction with traditional parties and concerns over immigration, economic instability, and national sovereignty.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD continues to lead in polls in several German states, with strong support in Saxony-Anhalt and other eastern regions, driven by anti-immigration and anti-EU rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Sverigedemokraterna has solidified its position as a major political force in Sweden, with growing support among younger voters and a focus on immigration and law-and-order policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's party is leading in French polls for the 2027 presidential election, capitalizing on voter dissatisfaction with Macron's government and concerns over immigration and economic issues.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP is leading in Norwegian polls, with strong support in local elections, driven by its stance on immigration, taxation, and energy policies.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK has made significant gains in local elections, positioning itself as a major challenger to the Conservative Party with its anti-immigration and anti-EU platform.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are experiencing internal divisions, with factions clashing over leadership, policy directions, and alliances. These divisions are evident in parties like Poland's PiS, Hungary's Fidesz/Tisza, Argentina's La Libertad Avanza, and Italy's Lega, often threatening their unity and electoral prospects.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS is facing internal conflicts over leadership and policy direction, with factions led by Jarosław Kaczyński and Mateusz Morawiecki vying for control and influence.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: The Tisza Party and Fidesz are locked in a power struggle, with Tisza pushing for constitutional reforms to limit Viktor Orbán's influence and Fidesz resisting these changes.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government is deeply divided, with factions led by his sister Karina Milei and advisor Santiago Caputo clashing over policy direction and leadership.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega is experiencing internal divisions over its alliance with Fratelli d'Italia and Salvini's leadership, with figures like Roberto Vannacci challenging the party's direction.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK faces internal challenges over candidate vetting and messaging, with some members accused of making controversial statements that undermine the party's credibility.

themes.title: Far-right governments target universities and education
themes.blurb: Far-right governments and parties are increasingly targeting universities and educational institutions, either through funding cuts, ideological control, or accusations of left-wing bias. This trend is evident in Hungary, the U.S., Argentina, and Germany, where governments are reshaping educational policies to align with their political agendas.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: The Tisza Party has proposed constitutional amendments to reclaim control over university foundations, aiming to reverse the previous government's policies that privatized higher education governance.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The Trump administration has targeted universities through policies like stricter accreditation rules and investigations into alleged left-wing bias, particularly in disciplines like gender studies and critical race theory.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government has proposed reforms to media laws that would classify journalists as politically exposed persons, requiring them to disclose assets and potentially limiting press freedom.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD has proposed changes to education policies, including homeschooling and revisions to history curricula, to align with its nationalist and anti-immigration stance.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK has criticized educational institutions for promoting 'woke' ideologies, advocating for policies that prioritize traditional values and national identity in schools.
